portfolio: Calderwood Bank has three facilities. Each month, every one is checked.
late: First, collection. A late servicer report was chased automatically.
layout: Two new tape columns. The AI mapped them, so no alert was raised.
rollforward: Then reconciliation. No AI here: code rolls April's tape forward to May.
gap: A US$412,004 gap. It traces to 27 loans missing from the May tape.
chargeoffs: Nine loans are charged off in the report but still live on the tape.
terms: Each test uses the terms in force for May, not the latest amendment.
trigger: Northmoor's delinquency is just below its trigger: an early warning.
whatif: If June is above 5.8%, the trigger breaks. The what-if shows it.
leverage: Bramble's leverage passes, unless a guarantee counts. An expert decides.
collateral: One car secures loans in two facilities. Possible double pledging.
triage: Every finding gets one of four outcomes. The AI suggests, the analyst decides.
noise: Noise is held back with its reason. Only eight items need action.
pack: The AI drafts each lender pack. Code inserts every figure, with its source.
approve: The analyst who prepared the cycle cannot approve. A second analyst does.
results: Measured, not forecast: all nine issues found, no false alarms.
